items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: You talked about going over to Europe, and I wanna talk about two major tours. You touched on the ’57 tour, I wanna get to that, but there was a ’56 tour with the Birdland All-Stars. Talk about the concert you had in Paris with Miles Davis and Lester Young.
We toured all over Germany and France with that, the Birdland All-Stars with Bud Powell doing the solo, René Urtreger had the trio with…
